title: Source-free conditional proof review: fixed old edge forms and the two-port one-discrepancy classification

work_record.proof_basis: Source-free reasoning informed by already published 1314 and 1337 method/report text. This is not result-blind regarding those predecessors.
work_record.timing: Written before the proposed new fixed-three-form enumeration; root stated that the 22-unit support prerequisite would be predeclared before that enumeration.
accessed: bounded lookup metadata for GDT1314 and GDT1337
experiments/yolo/gdt1314_binary_line_edge_capacity/REPORT.md (Why this is a useful change of test; Boundary assumption and retained positives; Verification and scope)
work_record.not_accessed: No raw/native cache, result JSON, images, implementation or newly counted edge/support results. No source meanings assigned. No new counts or tests performed.

fixed_model.inherit: Unchanged 1334/1337 global entry/exit bits, body partition, at most one glyph per body/port pair, one source body per written unit, free word ends, minimum adjacent mismatch cost, lexicographic tie order by 2*entry+exit, and unchanged 22-unit/group binding.
fixed_model.extension: Only own-reader occurrences of the three already published exact forms mol, damo and qokomo in the old 1314 EDGES population. No new edge census or additional counterform selection.
fixed_model.boundary_premise: Selected physical line-edge groups must be complete words, as conditionally stipulated by 1314. Unmarked across-line word continuation is outside this contract.
fixed_model.occurrences: Union original occurrence IDs without duplication; preserve reader separation. A form must actually occur in the selected old edge artifact for the given reader.

essential_bridge_gate.condition: Each of all 22 working units occurs in at least TWO distinct original STRICT whole-group occurrences, independently for each reader.
essential_bridge_gate.reason: Deleting or failing any one whole occurrence then leaves every glyph present in accepted STRICT data. Hence every alias used in an expanded-panel writer is already active in its accepted STRICT restriction.
essential_bridge_gate.failure_policy: If this prerequisite is not established, stop the universal transfer with INCOMPLETE_SCOPE. Do not infer that 1337's accepted-both strict classification covers a formerly dormant alternative made active only by an added edge word.
essential_bridge_gate.provenance_limit: The published statement that all 22 units survive the particular aman omission is not by itself the stronger prerequisite for every possible single omission. This review supplies no new support count.

restriction_proof: Suppose an active nontrivial unchanged writer makes at most one whole-occurrence discrepancy on STRICT union the fixed added edge occurrences.

Its restriction to STRICT makes at most one discrepancy. By the bridge gate every glyph and therefore both members of every chosen nontrivial body pair remain represented among accepted STRICT groups.

The complete 1337 classification therefore applies. Pair refinement retains every accepted word and its canonical preference. Its published star-graph consequence restricts any nontrivial partition to exactly one pair plus 20 singleton bodies.

1337's complete classification forces the strict discrepancy to be aman and the pair/port setting to belong to one of its feasible branches. The zero-discrepancy strict case is already excluded by 1334 under the same active-usage premise.

The entire one-occurrence budget is thus consumed inside STRICT. Every selected new edge occurrence must be rendered exactly; no second deletion, source reclassification or word-boundary repair is allowed.

adequate_small_check.for_each: Every feasible reader-specific pair and ordered pair-port branch in the complete 1337 classification, not merely the maximizing pair or one preferred witness.
adequate_small_check.formula: Original STRICT word constraints with ONLY the aman occurrence's unsupported constraints removed, plus all unchanged full-word/run constraints of the fixed selected edge occurrences and all immutable port/structural axioms.
adequate_small_check.free_parameters: Other singleton entry/exit bits remain existentially free and globally shared. A saved lexicographically least 1337 model is only one witness; its failure on a new edge word cannot prove branch UNSAT.
adequate_small_check.solver_scope: The original exact run/2SAT construction suffices. Reuse the complete branch list rather than restarting an all-pair search, provided its predecessor completeness and bridge prerequisite are retained.
adequate_small_check.negative: If all branches are UNSAT, no active nontrivial writer in the unchanged family can have at most one discrepancy on this expanded subset. This is a lower bound of at least two, not existence or exact radius two.
adequate_small_check.positive: A SAT assignment must receive full canonical word replay against the original strict panel and every selected edge occurrence. It only supplies a one-discrepancy witness on this explicitly expanded subset; not broader prose coverage or a physical script.
adequate_small_check.unfinished: Any UNKNOWN branch or unverified prerequisite prevents the universal negative conclusion.

small_analytic_witness.conditional_statement: If an accepted strict word has initial q immediately followed by o and selected old mol is a complete word, the m/q alias is impossible: their current hypothetical body, FREE left edge and actual right glyph o coincide, yet their observed first glyph differs.
small_analytic_witness.proof: Global canonical optimality implies local canonical optimality with actual fixed neighbors. Replacing just that first alias glyph affects only its adjacent port cost. The unique local cost-plus-portcode preference in the same FREE/o context cannot choose both m and q, regardless of the remainder of either word.
small_analytic_witness.limits: This checks a conditional written context, not a q/m meaning or physical identity. The relevant accepted strict and old edge provenance still must be bound by root. It is independent of the saved lex-least table. RF cfh/m and cph/m branches are not claimed excluded by this m/q argument and require their own complete constraints.

decision_and_scope: This can resolve a real scope question: whether the interior-only radius-one examples extend unchanged even to three already published prose-edge forms. The separate label-versus-prose singleton observation did not settle a prose-only extension.
The correct old STRICT radius-one result remains true under its original denominator and boundary scope, whatever this tiny extension returns.

No full edge population claim, source-language inference, error diagnosis, permissive error budget, new native finding, port/cost change, extra alias repair or search at two-or-more discrepancies follows.
The three counterforms are already exposed and intentionally selected; this is a necessary compatibility check, not held-out confirmation or a statistical test.
